description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIParser, which is responsible for parsing URIs into components according to RFC 3986. It uses regular expressions to dissect the URI string into scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment, and further parses the authority component into user info, host, and port.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIParser
classes.description: A class for parsing URIs into their components based on RFC 3986.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the percentEncoder instance used for URI normalization.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URI string into its components: scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment, and further splits authority into user info, host, and port.
